result.title: Beyond $L_\infty$-Norm Sets: Synthesizing Interpretable Non-Uniform Uncertainty Sets for Evaluation-Time State-Adversarial Robustness
result.summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents are vulnerable to perturbations of their observed state inputs. Prior works often constrain state adversaries with $L_p$-norm uncertainty sets and evaluate policy performance under the resulting perturbations. However, in continuous control tasks like robotics control, different state dimensions have distinct physical meanings and influence policy behavior to different degrees, which $L_p$-norm sets fail to capture or explain. Moreover, it is important to identify when and along which state dimensions a policy is vulnerable, independently of the algorithm used to train it. In this paper, we focus on evaluation-time attacks applied to pretrained policies. We propose \textbf{P}erformance-\textbf{D}egradation \textbf{N}on-\textbf{U}niform \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{S}et (\method{}), an interpretable formulation of uncertainty sets for state perturbations. \method{} is state-dependent, dimension-wise non-uniform, and can be synthesized online during policy evaluation. We first formulate an ideal constrained optimization problem for \method{} computation, then introduce a surrogate constraint to make the problem tractable. Experiments across multiple continuous-control environments, policy algorithms, and state attacks show that \method{} reveals variation in policy sensitivity across states and dimensions, while its performance degradation is moderately controlled.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对预训练 DRL 策略在连续控制任务中的状态扰动脆弱性，提出 PD-NUUS：一种状态依赖、逐维非均匀且可在评测时在线合成的不确定性集，并借助代理约束使原本的理想约束优化可解，从而在多个环境与策略上揭示不同状态与维度的敏感性差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“按状态、按维度”定位敏感坐标的评测思路，可能为 LVR 中哪些 latent 维度或视觉证据真正承载任务必要信息、以及内部状态扰动的敏感性诊断提供借鉴线索，但代理优化能否迁移到 latent 状态归因仍需核查。
